audit.rationale: Inspects packages for security vulnerabilities without modifying.

ci.rationale: Installs dependencies from lock file, modifying node_modules.

config.rationale: Manages npm configuration files via set, delete, and edit operations.

explain.rationale: Explains dependency relationships without modifying anything.

info.rationale: Queries and displays package metadata from the npm registry without modifying any state.

install.rationale: Installs packages and modifies node_modules and lock files.

list.rationale: Lists installed packages without modifying any state.

outdated.rationale: Checks for outdated packages without modifying.

publish.rationale: Publishes a package version to the public npm registry, irreversible.

run.rationale: Runs arbitrary package scripts which may modify local state.

search.rationale: Searches the npm registry for packages without modifying.

unpublish.rationale: Removes package versions from npm registry; with --force bypasses protections.

update.rationale: Updates packages to newer versions in node_modules and lock files.

view.rationale: Shows package registry information without modifying.
